name: bld6_card_circular_no_adjacent_subsets
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun s => ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), i ∈ s → j ∈ s → ((i : ℕ) + 1) % (n + 1) ≠ (j : ℕ))).card = Nat.fib n + Nat.fib (n + 2)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun s => ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), i ∈ s → j ∈ s → ((i : ℕ) + 1) % (n + 1) ≠ (j : ℕ))).card = Nat.fib n + Nat.fib (n + 2)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_card_no_adjacent_subsets: split cyclically non-adjacent subsets of Z/(n+1) by whether the last point n belongs to s. If not, s is a linear non-adjacent subset of Fin n: fib(n+2) of them by calc_card_no_adjacent_subsets n; if yes (n ≥ 2), then 0 and n-1 are excluded and the rest is a linear non-adjacent subset of the n-2 middle points: fib n by calc_card_no_adjacent_subsets (n-2); small n by decide. The total is the Lucas number L_(n+1).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), {s | ∀ (i j : Fin (n + 1)), i ∈ s → j ∈ s → (↑i + 1) % (n + 1) ≠ ↑j}.card = Nat.fib n + Nat.fib (n + 2)
